title: Kab aaoge ay baba
body:
moray baba
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ghar mein nahi lagta kab aaoge ay baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta kab aaoge ay baba
<<DIVIDER>>
neend udh gayi raaton ki aisi hai pareshani
ghar mein hai faqad baba chaayi hui veerani
wo zinda nahi rehta ho jaata hai jo tanha
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke nigahon mein dhundhla gaye sab manzar
jis simt bhi dekhun to aate hai nazar akbar
awaaz magar doo to koi bhi nahi aata
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad tumhe kar ke roti hoo mai raaton mein
lagta hai koi bibi aati hai hijabon mein
seene se laga kar wo roti hai mujhe baba
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwabon mein sakina ko dekha hai bahot maine
wo kis ke kate baazu thaame huwe roti hai
khoon kaano behta hai ruqsaar hai kyun neela
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta tha samar sheh ke halqoom pe jab khanjar
kehti thi raza us dam sughra yehi ro ro kar
khoon rota hai kyun baadal pani nahi barsaata
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
author: Samar Zaidi
